fields.appearance: Immaculately presented in durable formal clothes, moving with quiet efficiency.
fields.backstory: A household servant has managed the same troubled estate through three generations of careless owners.
fields.goals: Protect the household staff and prevent the family's debts from destroying their livelihoods.

fields.appearance: Discreet, observant, and dressed to remain unnoticed beside a more prominent employer.
fields.backstory: A personal attendant became the only confidant of an heir preparing to refuse an arranged marriage.
fields.goals: Keep the heir safe while finding a solution that will not punish innocent relatives.

fields.appearance: Strong-backed and plainly clothed, with hands roughened by years of varied physical work.
fields.backstory: A day laborer witnessed officials conceal structural faults after a deadly construction accident.
fields.goals: Win compensation for the victims and stop the unsafe project before another collapse.

fields.appearance: Aproned, flour-dusted, and quick-moving, with a habit of listening while others eat.
fields.backstory: A cook learned more about competing factions from dining-room scraps than most professional spies.
fields.goals: Use that knowledge to protect the kitchen staff and avoid becoming anyone's unwilling informant.

fields.appearance: Smells faintly of hay and leather, with practical boots and an easy manner around animals.
fields.backstory: A stable hand discovered that a prized mount had been deliberately trained to throw a particular rider.
fields.goals: Prevent the planned death and identify who tampered with the animal without endangering it.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a driver.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a driver and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a prisoner.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a prisoner and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.appearance: A one-eyed courier carries no weapons but knows every shortcut and guards a dragon egg.
fields.backstory: a one-eyed courier who knows every shortcut, refuses to carry weapons, and is secretly transporting a dragon egg.
fields.goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.
